A '''Tiss'shar assassin''' attempted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[President of the Tiss'sharl League|President]] [[Si-Di-Ri]] of the [[Tiss'sharl League/Legends|Tiss'sharl League]] approximately eight months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The assassin was unsuccessful, but managed to escape alive.

Prior to the assassination attempt on Si-Di-Ri, the [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] politician [[Geor-Dan-Thi]] rose to the position of [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] as [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Antha-Kres]], [[Secretary/Legends|Secretary]] [[Lai-O-Sid]], and Vice President [[Astre-De-Kay]] all died under questionable circumstances. Many, including Si-Di-Ri himself, believed Geor-Dan-Thi responsible for their assassination.
